flavors.long_description:

Say hello to popcorn with a serious citrus kick! Lemonade Popcorn takes fresh, tangy lemonade flavor and puts it on crunchy gourmet popcorn for a sweet-and-tart snack that's ridiculously refreshing. It's bright, zesty, and totally unexpected—like your favorite summertime lemonade got turned into popcorn!

🍋 Why You'll Love It

  • 🍿 Gourmet Popcorn — Crunchy, fluffy popcorn in every bite.
  • 🍋 Real Lemonade Flavor — That unmistakable sweet-tart lemonade taste.
  • ✨ Bright & Zesty — A refreshing citrus punch that wakes up your taste buds.
  • ☀️ Summer in a Bag — Perfect for warm-weather snacking—or whenever you need a little sunshine.
  • 💥 Totally Unexpected — Because popcorn doesn't have to be just butter and salt!

A Lemonade Stand… Made Popcorn. 🍋🍿

Sweet meets tangy in the most snackable way possible. Every bite delivers a burst of lemonade flavor followed by the satisfying crunch of gourmet popcorn.

It's refreshing. It's fun. And it's definitely not your average popcorn.

The Bottom Line

Lemonade Popcorn is sunshine, citrus, and crunch—all in one delicious bag. 🍋☀️🍿

It's Not Just Butter & Salt!

flavors.name: Muddy Buddy
flavors.long_description:
Chocolate. Peanut Butter. Powdered Sugar. Pure Snack Obsession. 🍿🤎

Get ready to meet your new favorite sweet treat! Muddy Buddy Popcorn takes crunchy gourmet popcorn and transforms it into a chocolate-and-peanut-butter dream. Coated in rich milk chocolate, creamy peanut butter, and a dusting of sweet powdered sugar, every handful delivers the deliciously indulgent flavor combination that dessert lovers can't resist.

🍫 Why You’ll Love It

  • 🍿 Gourmet Popcorn — Crunchy, snackable popcorn that makes the perfect base for a sweet treat.
  • 🍫 Milk Chocolate — Rich, chocolatey goodness in every bite.
  • 🥜 Creamy Peanut Butter — Adds that smooth, nutty flavor that pairs perfectly with chocolate.
  • ❄️ Powdered Sugar — A sweet, melt-in-your-mouth finish that completes the classic Muddy Buddy experience.
  • 🤎 Dessert-Worthy Deliciousness — All your favorite Muddy Buddy flavors in one craveable popcorn creation.

Your Favorite Chocolate-Peanut Butter Treat Just Got Popped! 🍫🥜

Imagine the irresistible combination of chocolate and peanut butter, finished with a sweet coating of powdered sugar. Now imagine enjoying all that goodness with a satisfying popcorn crunch!

Muddy Buddy Popcorn brings together three delicious ingredients for a sweet, rich, and seriously snackable treat. Perfect for movie nights, parties, gifting, or satisfying those chocolate cravings whenever they strike.

The Bottom Line

Rich milk chocolate. Creamy peanut butter. Sweet powdered sugar. One ridiculously delicious popcorn experience. 🍫🥜🍿

It’s Not Just Butter & Salt!
